section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1975
title: 22 ## Means Adopted to Commit Suicide A study of suicide cases according to the ‘means adopted’ for committing suicides revealed ‘poison’ to be the most used method. During 1975, 29.7 per cent suicides were committed by taking poison. The next important ‘means adopted’ for committing suicide was ‘hanging’ (20.3 per cent), followed by drowning (16.0 per cent), railways (5.9 per cent), fire (5.9 per cent), jumping (1.8 per cent), Weapons (1.1 per cent), fire-arms (1.0 per cent), and machine (0.5 per cent). The suicide grouped under ‘other causes’ accounted for 17.8 per cent of the total suicides registered during 1975. The details are presented in Table 3.
